entry.description: Distinguishing planar Brownian images of time sets and measures. The primary source reports: Troscheit reports mutual singularity of planar Brownian image laws for s-Frostman probability time measures on [0,1], with 0<s<1, when their normalized expected correlation profiles have a nonvanishing limsup difference, including the stated lattice versus non-lattice self-similar class under the open set condition and dimension restrictions. In a fixed-dimension two-contraction family, each parameter has finitely many possible exceptions, and sufficiently small dimensions give pairwise separation. Minkowski-neighborhood reconstruction transfers specified measure-law distinctions to compact image sets. Equal profiles need not identify the original measure. Direct AI connection: The primary paper says LLMs performed part of the two-contraction calculations and drafted much Lean code; the arguments and ideas are human-created, with some influence from formalization. Owner metadata names Claude and GPT6. Further checking: Establish which calculations and proof changes were AI contributions; audit profile asymptotics, mutual-singularity quantifiers, small-dimension restrictions and Minkowski reconstruction. The formalization proves renewal results only for the self-similar laws used, not the full cited renewal theorem. Author checks are not independent review. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Preserve provisional=1, low strict confidence, unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override. The general profile-separation theorem explicitly requires a common Frostman exponent 0<s<1; no unrestricted all-dimension or arbitrary-measure reconstruction claim is made.

entry.description: Further spherical Ramsey constructions and classification corollaries. The primary source reports: Strinz’s spherical-ramsey release reports that algebraic concyclic points plus at most three arbitrary points on the same circle are Ramsey, a nine-point radian progression is Ramsey exactly when exp(i theta) is algebraic, and a union of two Möbius images of finite algebraic spherical sets is Ramsey for dimensions>=2. entry.description: New reversible quantum-circuit architectures and resource improvements. The primary source reports: Gu, Kemeny, Yelin and Lukin report seven coherent computational-primitive circuit designs improving both Toffoli and peak-qubit counts over their cited baselines, and a new branch-decoding architecture that makes prime-field divsteps inversion practical without retaining a full branch-history stack. The point-addition designs expand the stated qubit/Toffoli trade-off; other tasks use their specified precision and failure budgets. These are constructions and branch-recovery mathematics, not a proof of global resource optimality. Direct AI connection: The paper describes evaluator-guided LLM circuit development; the dated Anthropic primary announcement names Claude Mythos5 and attributes new algebraic branch-decoding identities and largely autonomous circuit design, with human task specifications and review. Further checking: Audit the exact branch-decoding theorem and coherent phase/uncomputation correctness, rare-input failure budgets, circuit/resource accounting and comparisons. An independent evaluator is not an independent specialist audit; benchmark scores alone are not the inclusion basis. Do not transfer a selected17x gate comparison or12x decoding gain to every task or promise a practical quantum advantage. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Preserve provisional=1, low strict confidence, unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.

entry.description: Exact reconstruction of fourteen standardized elliptic-curve seeds and six base points. The primary source reports: Anthropic reports deterministic lrand48-state/timestamp recipes reproducing ten prime-field and four binary-field published curve seeds, and FreeLIP/NTL generator recipes reproducing six published prime-curve base points. The B-163 seed, the larger NIST prime base points, binary base points and the reasons some candidate curves were skipped remain unexplained. Matching recipes are exact computational constructions, not proof of the historical designers’ intent or of cryptographic security. Direct AI connection: The dated primary report credits Claude with recovering the generator patterns, timestamps and selected base-point constructions, under an Anthropic team’s investigation. Further checking: Independently compare the published standard values and recipes without treating matching code as historical documentation. entry.description: An independent counting-hierarchy proof for real feasibility with a fourth-level bound. The primary source reports: Meiburg reports existential real feasibility in BPP^(C3P), hence C4P, and for fixed w alternating real quantifier blocks a C(9w+17)P upper bound. The paper gives additional explicitly modeled bounds for exact SDP, PosSLP and square-root sum. This is an independent proof package and a stronger reported level bound than OpenAI3730, not a second first-public settlement of the general CH containment. Direct AI connection: The primary paper says ChatGPT discovered the proofs during conversations ending September29 and wrote essentially all mathematical content; Meiburg reports no nontrivial mathematical development role and an ongoing human digestion/exposition effort. Exact model is not disclosed. Further checking: Audit uniform bit-access and counting-oracle levels, randomized sign reconstruction, singular critical fibers and the input encodings/promises for each application. Independently compare the C4 bound with OpenAI3730's constituent manuscript and prior real-algebraic complexity work. September29 is an author-reported completion date, not established public visibility; first arXiv submission is October7. Human researchers had not completed the full proof digestion. Do not infer PSPACE=CH, deterministic C3 membership or a universal claim about every application. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Keep provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.

entry.description: A conditional nonsmooth hot-spots extension for simple first eigenvalues. The primary source reports: Assuming the explicitly stated smooth-domain no-critical-point theorem, Burdzy reports non-strict boundary-layer supremum/infimum equalities for first positive Neumann eigenfunctions on bounded simply connected planar domains with compact Neumann resolvent and simple first positive eigenvalue, without boundary smoothness. Boundary maximum/minimum equalities follow when the eigenfunction extends continuously to the closure. Spectral convergence is proved separately without the smooth-domain input. Direct AI connection: Burdzy says ChatGPT generated the note from multiple human prompts. He had not checked every detail, regards it as an obvious human-accessible corollary, and reports an almost identical simultaneous ChatGPT proof by Rodrigo Bañuelos, requesting equal credit rather than sole priority. Further checking: Keep the smooth-domain assertion as an explicit unverified external premise, not verification or unconditional extension of OpenAI3955. Audit conformal exhaustion, weighted square-integrability and spectral convergence. Retain compact resolvent, simplicity and non-strict conclusion; no assertion of a nonvanishing gradient or continuous boundary values for all rough domains. Resolve simultaneous credit and novelty without counting the unavailable Bañuelos note separately. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Keep provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.

entry.description: A converse to the discrete four-vertex theorem and realization continuity. The primary source reports: Josefsson reports a solution of Tabachnikov's2007 Problem2: every admissible cyclic positive radius sequence with at least two distinct plateau maxima and minima, for every n>=4, is realized by a simple strictly convex coherent polygon. The paper gives the corresponding side-tangent characterization, local C1 choices near nonconstant data and an explicit hexagon obstruction to a global continuous realization choice. These are original results developed with the formalization, not only Dahlberg's established forward theorem. Direct AI connection: Owner metadata says the mathematics and proofs were developed with Aristotle, Claude, Codex and DeepSeek assistance. It names Claude Opus4.8/Fable5/Opus5.5 through Claude Code/Archon and an Aristotle prover loop; the author takes responsibility and says paper and formalization were developed together. Further checking: Verify correspondence to Tabachnikov's exact Problem2 and the plateau convention, all-n realization and coherent-convex geometry. Check the signed-Menger-curvature regular-hexagon formulation underlying the global obstruction and the local C1 hypotheses; audit side-tangent endpoints separately. Establish earliest public paper visibility and later-prior-art history. Owner/compiler/comparator statements are not independent human proof review or replay here; forward classical theorems are not extra new records. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. entry.description: An explicit Hausdorff waist bound and repaired spherical localization argument. The primary source reports: Akopyan's package reports that for every continuous map S^n to R^k with1<=k<=n, some fiber has Mathlib unnormalized chordal (n-k)-dimensional Hausdorff measure at least1/(12*4^n*3^k), via a modification of Klartag's localization. It also reports repairing a discontinuous center-selection step in Memarian's spherical proof by cap quasiconcavity and continuous selection. The other headline waist theorems are established mathematics; the sharp intermediate-dimensional Hausdorff constant remains open. Direct AI connection: Primary metadata says Arseniy Akopyan prepared the formalization with Aristotle over several weeks. It does not establish whether Aristotle originated the explicit bound or gap repair, or only translated human mathematical modifications. Further checking: Establish novelty/materiality of the explicit positive bound and repaired proof route, as distinct from known waist formalizations. Audit spherical versus chordal metric, unnormalized Hausdorff measure and conversion factor omega_d/2^d, fiber quantifiers and selection continuity. Do not claim the sharp Gromov Hausdorff conjecture, or count all nine classical endpoints as new discoveries. Exact human/AI allocation and independent proof/statement replay remain unresolved. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Keep provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
